title: 查看调度器组件
description: 查看 kube-system 下的调度器 Pod
full_code: kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l component=kube-scheduler

hints.level_3: 👀 `kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l component=kube-scheduler`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l component=kube-scheduler

explanation: kube-scheduler 以 Pod 形式运行在 kube-system，用标签筛选查看。

title: 给节点打污点
description: 给 node-1 打 NoSchedule 污点
full_code: kubectl taint nodes node-1 gpu=true:NoSchedule

hints.level_2: 📖 NoSchedule 阻止无容忍 Pod 调度
hints.level_3: 👀 `gpu=true:NoSchedule`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：kubectl taint nodes node-1 gpu=true:NoSchedule

explanation: 污点 `key=value:effect`，effect 用 NoSchedule 阻止调度。

title: 节点不可调度
description: 将 node-1 标记为不可调度
full_code: kubectl cordon node-1

hints.level_3: 👀 `kubectl cordon node-1`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：kubectl cordon node-1

explanation: `cordon` 给节点打 unschedulable，新 Pod 不再调度到它。

title: 恢复节点调度
description: 取消 node-1 的不可调度状态
full_code: kubectl uncordon node-1

hints.level_3: 👀 `kubectl uncordon node-1`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：kubectl uncordon node-1

explanation: `uncordon` 移除 unschedulable，节点重新接收调度。

title: 驱逐节点 Pod
description: 排空节点以便维护
full_code: kubectl drain node-1 --ignore-daemonsets

hints.level_3: 👀 `kubectl drain node-1 --ignore-daemonsets`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：kubectl drain node-1 --ignore-daemonsets

explanation: `drain` 驱逐节点上所有可迁移 Pod，常配合 cordon 使用。

title: 查看 Pod 所在节点
description: 用 wide 输出查看 NODE 列
full_code: kubectl get pods -o wide

hints.level_3: 👀 `kubectl get pods -o wide`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：kubectl get pods -o wide

explanation: `-o wide` 展示 Pod 被调度到的节点，排障调度结果常用。

title: 查看调度器日志
description: 查看 kube-scheduler 日志
full_code: kubectl logs -n kube-system -l component=kube-scheduler

hints.level_1: 💡 查看调度器日志的命令
hints.level_3: 👀 `kubectl logs -n kube-system -l component=kube-scheduler`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：kubectl logs -n kube-system -l component=kube-scheduler

explanation: 调度器日志会记录绑定与调度失败原因。

title: 查看节点标签
description: 用 show-labels 列出节点标签
full_code: kubectl get nodes --show-labels

hints.level_3: 👀 `kubectl get nodes --show-labels`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：kubectl get nodes --show-labels

explanation: 节点标签是 nodeSelector/亲和性的匹配依据。

title: 打节点标签
description: 给 node-1 打 disktype=ssd 标签
full_code: kubectl label nodes node-1 disktype=ssd

hints.level_3: 👀 `kubectl label nodes node-1 disktype=ssd`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：kubectl label nodes node-1 disktype=ssd

explanation: 给节点打标签后，可用 nodeSelector 把 Pod 调度到这类节点。

title: 按节点过滤 Pod
description: 筛选调度到 node-1 的 Pod
full_code: kubectl get pods --field-selector spec.nodeName=node-1

hints.level_3: 👀 `kubectl get pods --field-selector spec.nodeName=node-1`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：kubectl get pods --field-selector spec.nodeName=node-1

explanation: 用 field-selector 按 spec.nodeName 找出已调度到某节点的 Pod。

title: 查看 PriorityClass
description: 列出优先级类
full_code: kubectl get priorityclasses

hints.level_3: 👀 `kubectl get priorityclasses`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：kubectl get priorityclasses

explanation: PriorityClass 决定调度顺序与抢占，值越大优先级越高。

title: 查看 Pod 调度详情
description: describe 查看调度事件与节点
full_code: kubectl describe pod web-1

hints.level_3: 👀 `kubectl describe pod web-1`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：kubectl describe pod web-1

explanation: describe 里的 Events 会显示调度失败（如节点资源不足/污点）。

title: 查看节点资源用量
description: 查看节点资源占用
full_code: kubectl top node

hints.level_1: 💡 查看节点资源用量的命令
hints.level_3: 👀 `kubectl top node`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：kubectl top node

explanation: `kubectl top node` 查看节点实际资源占用，判断是否资源不足导致调度失败。

title: 查看 Pending Pod
description: 筛选处于 Pending 的 Pod
full_code: kubectl get pods -A --field-selector status.phase=Pending

hints.level_1: 💡 查看未调度 Pod 的命令
hints.level_3: 👀 `kubectl get pods -A --field-selector status.phase=Pending`
hints.level_4: 📝 正确答案：kubectl get pods -A --field-selector status.phase=Pending

explanation: Pending 通常是调度器还没成功绑定（无可用节点/资源不足/污点）。

title: nodeSelector 定向调度
description: 只调度到 ssd 标签的节点
full_code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: ssd
spec:
  nodeSelector:
    disktype: ssd
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

hints.level_3: 👀 nodeSelector 匹配节点标签，只有带该标签的节点被选中
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: ssd
spec:
  nodeSelector:
    disktype: ssd
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

explanation: `nodeSelector` 按节点标签定向调度，是最简单的调度约束。

title: 固定节点 nodeName
description: 直接把 Pod 绑到 node-1
full_code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: pinned
spec:
  nodeName: node-1
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

hints.level_3: 👀 spec.nodeName 绕过调度器直接绑定节点
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: pinned
spec:
  nodeName: node-1
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

explanation: `spec.nodeName` 直接指定节点，调度器跳过选择过程。

title: required 节点亲和性
description: 硬性要求调度到 ssd 节点
full_code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: aff
spec:
  affinity:
    nodeAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
        nodeSelectorTerms:
        - matchExpressions:
          - key: disktype
            operator: In
            values:
            - ssd
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

hints.level_3: 👀 required 是硬约束，没有满足节点就不调度
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: aff
spec:
  affinity:
    nodeAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
        nodeSelectorTerms:
        - matchExpressions:
          - key: disktype
            operator: In
            values:
            - ssd
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

explanation: nodeAffinity 的 required 子句是硬性要求，比 nodeSelector 支持 In/NotIn 等操作符。

title: preferred 节点亲和性
description: 优先调度到 ssd 节点但不强制
full_code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: pref
spec:
  affinity:
    nodeAffinity:
      preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      - weight: 100
        preference:
          matchExpressions:
          - key: disktype
            operator: In
            values:
            - ssd
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

hints.level_3: 👀 preferred 是软偏好，权重影响但不强制
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: pref
spec:
  affinity:
    nodeAffinity:
      preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      - weight: 100
        preference:
          matchExpressions:
          - key: disktype
            operator: In
            values:
            - ssd
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

explanation: preferred 子句按 weight 加分，节点不满足也能调度，只是优先级低。

title: Pod 亲和性
description: 与 web 标签的 Pod 同节点调度
full_code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: co
spec:
  affinity:
    podAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      - labelSelector:
          matchExpressions:
          - key: app
            operator: In
            values:
            - web
        topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

hints.level_3: 👀 与满足标签的 Pod 在相同拓扑域内调度
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: co
spec:
  affinity:
    podAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      - labelSelector:
          matchExpressions:
          - key: app
            operator: In
            values:
            - web
        topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

explanation: podAffinity 让新 Pod 与已有 Pod 靠近（同节点/同区域）。

title: Pod 反亲和性
description: 避免与 web Pod 同节点
full_code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: anti
spec:
  affinity:
    podAntiAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      - labelSelector:
          matchExpressions:
          - key: app
            operator: In
            values:
            - web
        topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

hints.level_3: 👀 避免与特定 Pod 在同一拓扑域，常用于分散副本
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: anti
spec:
  affinity:
    podAntiAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
      - labelSelector:
          matchExpressions:
          - key: app
            operator: In
            values:
            - web
        topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

explanation: podAntiAffinity 让副本分散到不同节点/区域，提升可用性。

title: 容忍污点
description: 容忍 NoSchedule 污点以便调度
full_code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: util
spec:
  tolerations:
  - key: gpu
    operator: Exists
    effect: NoSchedule
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

hints.level_3: 👀 容忍匹配污点的 key/effect 才能调度
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: util
spec:
  tolerations:
  - key: gpu
    operator: Exists
    effect: NoSchedule
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

explanation: Pod 声明 tolerations 匹配节点污点后，才能被调度到该节点。

title: 容忍 key 匹配
description: 只容忍指定 key 的污点
full_code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: gpu
spec:
  tolerations:
  - key: gpu
    operator: Equal
    value: "true"
    effect: NoSchedule
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

hints.level_3: 👀 Equal 操作符要求 key+value 都匹配
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: gpu
spec:
  tolerations:
  - key: gpu
    operator: Equal
    value: "true"
    effect: NoSchedule
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

explanation: Equal 容忍要求污点 key 与 value 都匹配，比 Exists 更精确。

title: PriorityClass 定义
description: 定义高优先级类
full_code:
apiVersion: scheduling.k8s.io/v1
kind: PriorityClass
metadata:
  name: high-priority
value: 1000000
globalDefault: false

hints.level_3: 👀 值越大优先级越高，可抢占低优先级 Pod
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：apiVersion: scheduling.k8s.io/v1
kind: PriorityClass
metadata:
  name: high-priority
value: 1000000
globalDefault: false

explanation: PriorityClass 定义优先级，调度器先调度高优先级，必要时抢占。

title: Pod 引用优先级
description: 指定 pod 使用 high-priority 类
full_code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: hp
spec:
  priorityClassName: high-priority
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

hints.level_3: 👀 spec.priorityClassName 引用 PriorityClass
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: hp
spec:
  priorityClassName: high-priority
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

explanation: Pod 通过 priorityClassName 指定优先级，参与调度排队与抢占。

title: 拓扑分布约束
description: 副本按可用区分散
full_code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: web
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  topologySpreadConstraints:
  - maxSkew: 1
    topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
    whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
    labelSelector:
      matchLabels:
        app: web
  containers:
  - name: web
    image: nginx

points.hint: 补充「标签 app 的值」

hints.level_3: 👀 控制副本在各拓扑域的分布，避免集中
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: web
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  topologySpreadConstraints:
  - maxSkew: 1
    topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
    whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
    labelSelector:
      matchLabels:
        app: web
  containers:
  - name: web
    image: nginx

explanation: TopologySpreadConstraints 让副本按区域/节点均匀分布。

title: 资源请求（调度依据）
description: 声明 CPU 请求供调度
full_code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: r
spec:
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: "500m"
        memory: "256Mi"

hints.level_3: 👀 调度器按 requests 评估节点剩余容量
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: r
spec:
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: "500m"
        memory: "256Mi"

explanation: 调度器只依据 requests（而非 limits）判断节点是否放得下。

title: 自定义调度器
description: 用自定义 schedulerName 调度
full_code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: custom
spec:
  schedulerName: my-scheduler
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

hints.level_3: 👀 默认调度器是 default-scheduler，可指定其它调度器
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: custom
spec:
  schedulerName: my-scheduler
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

explanation: spec.schedulerName 指定自定义调度器，实现个性化的调度策略。

title: DaemonSet 逐节点调度
description: DaemonSet 在每个节点各跑一个
full_code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: fluentd
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: fluentd
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: fluentd
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: fluentd
        image: fluent/fluentd

points.hint: 补充「标签 app 的值」

hints.level_3: 👀 DaemonSet 在每个节点各放一个 Pod，不经过常规调度选择
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: fluentd
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: fluentd
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: fluentd
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: fluentd
        image: fluent/fluentd

explanation: DaemonSet 由控制器保证每节点一个，调度器不做放置决策。

title: PodDisruptionBudget
description: 保证可用副本数
full_code:
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: web-pdb
spec:
  minAvailable: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web

points.hint: 补充「标签 app 的值」

hints.level_3: 👀 PDB 限制自愿驱逐（节点维护）时可同时不可用数量
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: web-pdb
spec:
  minAvailable: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web

explanation: PDB 保证自愿中断（如 drain）时仍有足够副本在线。

title: 污点 + 容忍组合
description: 节点污点与 Pod 容忍配合
full_code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: dedicated
spec:
  nodeSelector:
    dedicated: infra
  tolerations:
  - key: dedicated
    operator: Exists
    effect: NoSchedule
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

hints.level_3: 👀 节点打污点拒绝普通 Pod，专用 Pod 用容忍 + 标签定向
hints.level_4:
📝 正确答案：apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: dedicated
spec:
  nodeSelector:
    dedicated: infra
  tolerations:
  - key: dedicated
    operator: Exists
    effect: NoSchedule
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: nginx

explanation: 污点阻止默认 Pod，专用 Pod 用 tolerations 匹配并通过 nodeSelector 定向。
